stem: Why should canopy work be tied to a defined objective rather than simply removing as much tissue as possible?
choices: Training changes plant structure and resource distribution, so the amount and timing of work should support a specific crop goal
More removed tissue always increases yield
Canopy work has no effect on recovery
Every cultivar should receive identical treatment
rationale: Canopy work is a purposeful intervention. Excessive or poorly timed removal can reduce productive leaf area or increase stress.
